Hi Elena —

Thanks for the sample usage and great questions. TL;DR: we separate two charge buckets on the invoice (context allocation + compute tokens) and apply a lightweight smoothing/crediting rule for KV cache hits. Below is the concise policy and two worked examples using your numbers.

Policy summary (short):
- Context allocation (one-time per knowledge bundle): billed in 1,024-token buckets, rounded up per bundle. This is an allocation SKU that appears as a separate line item on the invoice.
- Compute tokens (generation + input tokens): billed per-actual-token but subject to two practical adjustments we apply automatically: 
  * Streaming quantum: per-stream message minimum = 8 tokens. Each streaming message is rounded up to the nearest 8 tokens before summing.
  * Daily invoice rounding: after we sum compute tokens for the billing day, we round the daily total to the nearest 1,024 tokens when generating the invoice line (this keeps invoices compact for many tiny calls).
- KV / prefix smoothing credit: when a request hits an existing KV cache entry within 30 minutes of the entry creation, we apply a 25% credit to the compute tokens billed for that request (credit is applied to compute tokens only, not to context allocation).

Worked examples (based on your sample):
1) Long-context RAG read + single stream response
- Knowledge bundle: 120,000 tokens -> context allocation = ceil(120000 / 1024) = 118 buckets -> billed as 118 * (context SKU price) on invoice.
- Request: 1,200 input tokens + 600 output tokens streamed as 6 messages of ~100 token chunks.
  * Per-message rounding: each ~100 chunk rounded up to nearest 8 -> 104 each, 6 * 104 = 624 billed compute tokens.
  * Daily rounding (if only this request that day): compute sum 624 -> round to nearest 1,024 -> 1,024 billed compute tokens.
  * If KV cache hit applies (request reused prefix within 30m): apply 25% credit -> billed compute = 768 then daily rounding -> 1,024 (still same in this small example).

2) Micro-requests pattern (500 calls of 40 tokens streamed as 4 messages of ~10 tokens)
- Per-call: 4 messages * 8-token quantum = 32 tokens (rounded per message to 8).
- Day total raw compute tokens = 500 * 32 = 16,000 -> daily rounding to nearest 1,024 = 16,384 tokens billed.
- If 40% of calls hit KV cache within window -> effective billed compute = 16,384 - (0.4 * raw_compute * 25% credit rounded appropr) — we show the precise line on the draft invoice.

Pilot discount options: we can offer a time-bound pilot discount and separate pilot credits. For a clean deal structure we typically propose: 
- Option A: 35% off compute tokens for first 3 months for pilot (minimum commit $25k/mo). Context allocation charges are discounted 15% (one-time).
- Option B: 30% off compute tokens and no minimum commit, but we withhold caching credits from cross-tenant reuse (only single-app cache credit).

Next steps I suggest:
1) We’ll produce a short sample invoice (line items: context allocation, compute tokens pre-discount, compute tokens post-discount, net VAT) based on your CSV — attached pricing deck has the template.
2) Quick 30-min call to confirm which pilot option you prefer. I’m available Monday 10–12 PT or Tuesday afternoon.

Attached: redwood-pricing-deck.pdf (pricing template + invoice mock).

Thanks — happy to tweak.
